name: radix-alert-dialog
title: Radix Alert Dialog
description: An accessible alert dialog built on Radix UI with smooth Motion 3D perspective entrance and exit animations, customizable sizes, and media slots.

agentMetadata.intent: Require explicit confirmation before an irreversible action.
a11yConstraints: Preserve focus trapping and always provide a cancel action.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion perspective spring entrance with backdrop presence transition.
compositionRules: Use AlertDialogTrigger asChild for the initiating control.
compositionRecipes: Compose with radix/button for destructive confirmation.
